# pve_realm_ldap (Resource)

Manages an LDAP authentication realm (`type=ldap`) in Proxmox VE (`/access/domains`). The upstream server validates that the supplied options fit the realm type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_realm_ldap" "corp" {
  realm        = "corp"
  comment      = "Corporate LDAP"
  server1      = "ldap.example.com"
  server2      = "ldap2.example.com"
  port         = 636
  mode         = "ldaps"
  verify       = true
  base_dn      = "dc=example,dc=com"
  password     = "s3cret-bind-password" # stored by PVE in /etc/pve/priv/realm/corp.pw
  user_attr    = "uid"
  user_classes = "inetorgperson, posixaccount"
  default      = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `realm` (String) Authentication domain ID (PVE realm name, up to 32 characters).

### Optional

- `base_dn` (String) LDAP base domain name (up to 256 characters).
- `bind_dn` (String) LDAP bind domain name (up to 256 characters).
- `capath` (String) Path to the CA certificate store. Defaults to `/etc/ssl/certs`.
- `case_sensitive` (Boolean) Username is case-sensitive. Defaults to `true`.
- `cert` (String) Path to the client certificate.
- `certkey` (String) Path to the client certificate key.
- `check_connection` (Boolean) Check the bind connection to the server when saving. Defaults to `false`.
- `comment` (String) Description shown in the PVE login window when the realm is selected.
- `default` (Boolean) Use this realm as the default realm.
- `filter` (String) LDAP filter for user sync (up to 2048 characters).
- `group_classes` (String) The objectclasses for groups, comma-separated. Defaults to `groupOfNames, group, univentionGroup, ipausergroup`.
- `group_dn` (String) LDAP base domain name for group sync. Defaults to `base_dn`.
- `group_filter` (String) LDAP filter for group sync (up to 2048 characters).
- `group_name_attr` (String) LDAP attribute representing a group's name. Defaults to the first value of the DN.
- `mode` (String) LDAP protocol mode. Must be one of `ldap`, `ldaps`, `ldap+starttls`. Defaults to `ldap`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) LDAP bind password. PVE stores it in `/etc/pve/priv/realm/<realm>.pw` and never returns it; the provider only sends it when you set it.
- `port` (Number) Server port. Must be between 1 and 65535.
- `secure` (Boolean) Use secure LDAPS protocol. Deprecated upstream: use `mode` instead.
- `server1` (String) Server IP address (or DNS name), up to 256 characters.
- `server2` (String) Fallback server IP address (or DNS name).
- `sslversion` (String) LDAPS TLS/SSL version. Must be one of `tlsv1`, `tlsv1_1`, `tlsv1_2`, `tlsv1_3`. Upstream recommends 1.2 or newer.
- `sync_attributes` (String) Comma-separated `key=value` pairs mapping LDAP attributes to PVE user fields, e.g. `email=mail`. Defaults to the same-named LDAP attribute per PVE user field.
- `sync_defaults_options` (String) Default options for realm synchronizations in PVE `realm-sync-options` format, e.g. `enable-new=1,scope=both`.
- `tfa` (String) Two-factor authentication configuration in PVE `pve-tfa-config` format (e.g. `type=oath`). The realm index reports the active provider instead (`yubico` or `oath`).
- `user_attr` (String) LDAP user attribute name.
- `user_classes` (String) The objectclasses for users, comma-separated. Defaults to `inetorgperson, posixaccount, person, user`.
- `verify` (Boolean) Verify the server's SSL certificate. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String) Realm configuration digest used by PVE to prevent concurrent modifications (read-only).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing LDAP realm by its realm ID.
terraform import pve_realm_ldap.corp corp
```
